delivery.en: Parcels: a neighbour or the Liechtensteinische Post office
delivery.zh: 包裹交給鄰居，或到列支敦斯登郵局領取

readback.en: Local numbers go in short groups; 0 as null; Swiss francs; halb acht is 7:30
readback.zh: 本地號碼約七位、分短組唸，0 唸 null；金額用瑞士法郎；halb acht＝7:30

fraud.en: A Liechtensteinische Post fee or address link, or a fake officer asking for bank codes, are scams
fraud.zh: 冒充列支敦斯登郵局要補運費或改地址、假警察要銀行碼的都是詐騙

habits.en: Sie by default; du once offered. German only; write ss, not ß. Do not assume Swiss French or fedpol terms.
habits.zh: 預設用 Sie，對方提議再改 du。只講德語，寫 ss 不用 ß。不要套用瑞士法語或 fedpol。

stall_local.en: Get stuck on e-banking failing in a cellar, a dead card reader, or reading glasses upstairs.
stall_local.zh: 卡在網銀在地下室沒訊號、讀卡機沒電、老花眼鏡在樓上。

reason.en: Swiss Post locker brand; not confirmed for Liechtenstein
reason.zh: 瑞士郵局櫃品牌，在列支敦斯登是否通用未證實

reason.en: Swiss locker network; not confirmed locally
reason.zh: 瑞士包裹櫃網路，當地是否使用未證實

reason.en: Swiss payment app; use in Liechtenstein was not confirmed
reason.zh: 瑞士支付 App，在當地是否通用未證實

reason.en: Swiss federal police; Liechtenstein has Landespolizei
reason.zh: 瑞士聯邦警察，當地是 Landespolizei

reason.en: Swiss French for 80; Liechtenstein is German-speaking
reason.zh: 瑞士法語「80」的說法，當地使用德語

talk_style_diff.en: Same Sie/du courtesy as Switzerland, but German only: do not switch into French or Italian. Formal calls stay in standard German; dialect may appear with people who use it.
talk_style_diff.zh: 敬語仍是先 Sie 再 du，但只使用德語，不要切到法語或義大利語。正式場合用標準德語，對方用方言再跟。

uncertain: TWINT、PickPost、MyPost24、Natel 在列支敦斯登是否日常使用，此次未找到明確官方說明。
電話接聽用 Hallo 較符合德語習慣；面對面的 Grüezi 是否也常用於電話，未找到當地來源。
